subject: Realtime chat slowdown — status, mitigations, and customer checklist
messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: harini@greenlinehealth.com, platform@greenlinehealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Realtime chat slowdown — initial report and quick mitigations

Hi Harini / Greenline platform team,

We wanted to let you know we observed a global increase in response latency on streaming/chat endpoints starting ~07:45 PDT (logs show token emission delays and intermittent chunk stalls). The impact: slower interactive responses for some multi-turn conversations (primarily conversations that exceed ~512 tokens).

What we know so far:
- Scope: ~6% of requests routed to the primary US cluster experienced token cadence drops (highest impact on sessions with >512 context).
- Root cause (initial): a transient kernel scheduling regression combined with uneven batching on a subset of shards.
- Customer-visible symptom: delayed first tokens and occasional multi-second gaps mid-response.

Immediate mitigations we pushed (already applied):
1) Temporarily disabled large-window continuous-batching for affected shards (reduces batching latency variance).
2) Forced fallback to smaller quantized kernel on 3 edge nodes to reduce per-token CPU spikes.
3) Enabled more aggressive KV-cache eviction for long conversations to avoid load amplification.

Recommended short-term client actions (low-effort):
- If you have a streaming fallback path in client, consider switching to non-streaming / chunked polling for heavy sessions (we can provide sample toggles).
- Add exponential backoff for stream reconnects (start 250ms, max 2s).
- Set a short client-side chunk timeout of 1200ms to avoid long-hanging requests; that will allow your UI to drop into a graceful spinner and attempt retry.

Attachments: incident_telemetry_excerpt.txt (short trace), mitigation-checklist.md

We will follow up within 2 hours with a fuller action plan and ETA for a sustained fix. Apologies for the disruption — we know interactive latency is critical for your agents.

Best,
Aditya Rao
SRE, Redwood Inference

> 2) Can you estimate how long the mitigation will affect throughput — we’re optimizing for agent throughput during business hours.
>

>
> -Harini
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, harini@greenlinehealth.com, platform@greenlinehealth.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Realtime chat slowdown — initial report and quick mitigations

Hi Harini — quick answers and an ops playbook we can apply on your behalf.

Short answers:
- Client toggle: set streaming_mode="chunked" and max_chunk_tokens=128. That reduces the probability of hitting long-continuous generation windows which trigger the regressed kernel path.
- Throughput impact: the server-side mitigations we pushed reduce tail latency but also lower aggregate throughput for the affected shards by ~8-12% while active. We expect to lift the temporary limits after a targeted kernel patch and shard rebalance — ETA 18-24 hours.

Customer ops checklist (one-click items we can coordinate):
1) We can flip your account-level stream_preference to "chunked" for the next 24 hours — will require no code change on your side. Confirm and we’ll do it instantly.
2) If you prefer client-side: set stream_timeout_ms=1200 and max_chunk_tokens=128.
3) Add reconnect_backoff: {initial_ms:250, multiplier:2, max_ms:2000}.
4) If you see persistent stalls, switch the session to non-streaming with a 500ms poll interval.

We can schedule a 15-min call to apply these with your SREs — propose 10:00 PDT.

We’ll also share a short playbook with code snippets (attachment: mitigation-checklist.md).

Marissa
Account Lead — Enterprise Success
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: harini@greenlinehealth.com, platform@greenlinehealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Realtime chat slowdown — status update and post-incident plan

Hi all — quick update after the account toggle and additional remediation:

What we changed (15 Sep 2025 09:00 PDT):
- Flipped Greenline account stream_preference -> "chunked" (server-side override).
- Drained affected shards and forced a controlled rebalance across nodes.
- Deployed a targeted kernel patch to 100% of the US-serving pool at 08:50 PDT.

Current status:
- Median token emission latency is back to baseline. Tail (95th/99th) improved but still showing modest elevation in some long-context flows.
- Customer-visible: The agents should see near-normal responsiveness; please confirm if there are any lingering stalls.

Next steps / postmortem items (we will follow up with a full postmortem by EOD tomorrow):
1) Root cause analysis and timeline — kernel scheduler regression + batching heuristics mismatch.
2) Permanent mitigation plan — kernel fix + improved shard-level batching introspection.
3) Offer: 25% credit for impacted usage window (we’ll route to invoices team and send a formal credit note).
4) Suggested hardening for Greenline: enable "adaptive_chunking" (new opt-in) and a short-lived canary route to EU cluster if you want extra isolation for business hours.

Attachments: postmortem-draft.docx (internal draft) — we will sanitize and share a customer-facing postmortem tomorrow.

Please reply if you observe anything off; otherwise we’ll mark this as mitigated and share the final postmortem in 24 hours.

Thanks,
Aditya
SRE — Redwood Inference
